title: Dialogue Between Lutnick and President Sheinbaum Will Be Useful in Trade Negotiations, Ebrard Says
author: Alejandro Alegría
content:
_This article by[Alejandro
Alegría](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Alejandro%20Alegr%C3%ADa)
originally appeared in the [September 9, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/09/09/economia/dialogo-entre-
lutnick-y-la-presidenta-sheinbaum-sera-de-utilidad-en-negociacion-comercial-
ebrard), Mexico’s premier left wing daily newspaper._

Mexico City. The dialogue between U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and
President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo will be useful for trade negotiations
between the two countries, said Marcelo Ebrard Casaubón, head of the
Secretariat of Economy.

The official said, through a message on his account on the social network X,
that the meeting his U.S. counterpart held with the Mexican president was
**“cordial.”** “I estimate it will be very useful for the ongoing trade
negotiations with the United States,” said Ebrard Casaubón, who earlier
indicated that Lutnick had been unable to travel to Mexico due to adverse
conditions.

> “I estimate it will be very useful for the ongoing trade negotiations with
> the United States.”
>
> Marcelo Ebrard, Economy Secretary

In addition, the head of the Economy Secretariat announced that this Thursday
he will meet with the U.S. negotiating team in Washington “to keep advancing.”
The official did not yet indicate the dates on which the **fourth bilateral
round of the USMCA review** will take place, which is so far expected to be
held this month.

Both Mexico and the United States agreed to continue with the fourth round of
the bilateral USMCA review in the first weeks of September. So far, the dates
to continue the dialogue have not been defined.

Mexico and the United States also maintain other negotiations to resolve their
various trade disputes, such as the one related to **vehicles, steel, and
semiconductors**.
